templates.subject: Lighthouse 1893 — set your availability at footballhome.org
templates.body:
Hi guys,

We track availability for games and practice on footballhome.org — which works on your phone or computer, and also installs as an app on your phone.

How to get in:
1. Open https://footballhome.org on your phone or computer
2. On your phone? Tap Share → Add to Home Screen (iOS) or Install app (Android) so it lives on your home screen like a real app.
3. Tap Sign In
4. Tap "Continue with Google" — use the same email you're registered with on LeagueApps

No Google account? No problem:
• Tap "Sign in with email & password"
• Tap "Forgot / set password"
• Enter your LeagueApps email — we'll send you a link to set a password. Set it, then sign in.

Once you're in, you'll see your week under My Schedule. For every game / practice, just tap:
• Going
• Can't go

You must set availability for EVERY event on your weekly schedule. Not sure? Tap Can't go — you can always change it later if plans free up.

Please sign in and set your availability for this week. There's also a button to set your **recurring** availability — everyone should commit to 2 recurring practices if you can. Then you only need to change it the week of if you CANNOT make it.

Only use recurring if your schedule actually allows it — we don't want no-shows. If your week is unpredictable, just set availability week-by-week.

Going forward we'll be fining no-shows AND anyone who shows up without setting their availability — it hurts the teams and the club when we can't plan.

Any questions, DM me — let's keep the chat clear so everyone can see this message.

Thanks,
Lighthouse 1893 SC
{outreach_email}
